entity: US high-risk (PMA) device changes: share filed as 30-day notices
what_we_add: the rise: 19% of changes in 2000-04 to 64% from 2010 on; Medtronic defibrillator line P980016 with 928 changes, 621 of them 30-day notices
why: JAMA Network Open (Dubin 2023) puts 30-day notices at 67.3% of 10,776 PMA supplements, 2008-2021, within 25% of our 64% for 2010 on; RAPS says the same in words. No usable source states the 2000-04 baseline or the rise (the JAMA 2014 'increased markedly' quote is blocked and not paywalled, so ignored); a stricter reading that a level-only source can't match a rise headline would change the bin.
